:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/changeType.xml).
:::

`changeType` is the attribute that states the type of a change in the change markup of an element. It is written together with [`changeMark`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/change-mark/) and [`reasonForUpdateRefIds`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/reason-for-update-ref-ids/). It is optional.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 701 elements carry this attribute. The following table shows the 12 elements that appear in the most schemas.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acronym` | 28 | Optional |
| `acronymDefinition` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionListItemPara` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionRandomList` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionRandomListItem` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionSequentialList` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionSequentialListItem` | 28 | Optional |
| `changeInline` | 28 | Optional |
| `circuitBreakerRef` | 28 | Optional |
| `controlAuthority` | 28 | Optional |
| `controlAuthorityGroup` | 28 | Optional |
| `copyright` | 28 | Optional |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided by the XML schema. The default BREX (Business Rules Exchange) has no rule that lists the values of this attribute.

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `changeTypeAttType` (based on `xs:NMTOKEN`). The values are the enumeration `add`, `delete`, `modify` |

## Meaning of the values

| Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `add` | The element was added |
| `modify` | The element was changed |
| `delete` | The element was removed |

## Related rules

- An element that has `changeMark` but no `changeType` is treated as an added element (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.1).
- The children of an element marked `add` or `delete` need no change markup. Markup on the children is ignored when the data module is displayed.
- An element marked `modify` can contain elements marked `add`, `modify` or `delete`.
- An issue whose `issueType` is not `changed` cannot contain change markup (BREX-S1-00036 of the default BREX. The XPath of the rule excludes issues of type `changed`, `status`, `rinstate-changed` and `rinstate-status`).

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). The value is in `change` of nodes and references, and in `changeMarks[]`, the list for the whole data module |
| Add it in an edit | `marking` of [`edit_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/edit-data-module/). An added element gets `add` and an element to remove gets `delete`. When an element is moved inside the same parent, the parent element gets `modify` |
| Remove it when the next issue is started | [`start_revision`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/start-revision/). It removes the change markup of the previous issue and takes out the elements marked `delete` |

Taking out the elements marked `delete` in the next issue is not stated in the parts of the specification that were read. It is this stack's interpretation.
